card.name: Digits inside numbers and years
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, mostly the second or third digit of a confidence interval bound, a year, or a table count. It responds to the digit itself, not to the words around it.

modes.label: Confidence interval bounds
modes.description: A digit after the decimal point in a hazard ratio or confidence interval.

modes.label: Years in dates
modes.description: The third digit of an 18th-century year in a birth or death date.

modes.label: Table counts and doses
